summary: Screenshot cheat for Words with Friends, CrossPlay & More!
description: Word Breaker is a powerful word game cheat and helper designed to help you win more games and score higher in favorites like Words With Friends, Wordfeud, Scrabble Go, and NYT CrossPlay. Stuck on a board? Not sure what move gives the best score? Just import a screenshot and let Word Breaker do the heavy lifting. Whether you call it a cheat, a solver, or a helper, Word Breaker gives you the edge you need—fast. It also works great as a general word helper for puzzles like Wordle, anagrams, crosswords, jumbles, and even classroom learning. Why Word Breaker? Word Breaker isn’t just a word finder—it’s a strategy and optimization tool. See every possible move, learn how to create multiple crosswords in one play, and track which tiles are still in the bag so you can plan ahead like a pro. Many players use Word Breaker as a learning tool to improve spelling, vocabulary, and word strategy. Teachers even use it in classrooms to help students explore English in a fun way. TOP FEATURES 🚀 Fast word cheat & helper – instant results 📸 Screenshot Importing Automatically reads your game board into the Board Solver Supports screenshots from: •Words With Friends •Wordfeud •Scrabble Go •CrossPlay 🧠 Board Solver – find the best scoring moves, not just any word 👻 Ghost Mode – peek at the board underneath your game 🧩 Classic Solver Mode – works with any puzzle: anagrams, crosswords, hangman, jumbles, and more 🔤 Supports wildcards & blank tiles with pattern matching 🎯 Remaining Tiles Tracker – predict what letters are still left 📚 Offline dictionaries – no internet required, all dictionaries are free ⚙️ Highly customizable – filters by word length and more 🎨 3 themes – Light, Dark, and the classic wood grain look 🌍 7 languages supported – English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese How to Take a Screenshot Press and hold Volume Down + Power for one second On some phones, use Home + Power Tips for Best Screenshot Results Zoom out fully so the entire board is visible Make sure all playable tiles are on your rack Remove overlays like chat bubbles or notifications Privacy Notice This app collects device identifiers (such as IP address and advertising ID) to support ads and analytics. You can opt out or learn more in the Privacy Center within the app settings.
